response.sql: WITH rating_prices AS (SELECT rating, AVG(rental_rate / NULLIF(rental_duration, 0)) AS avg_per_day FROM film GROUP BY rating), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_per_day) AS across_rating_avg FROM rating_prices) SELECT AVG(rp.avg_per_day) AS avg_per_day_price, AVG(rp.avg_per_day - o.across_rating_avg) AS avg_above_across_rating FROM rating_prices rp CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE rp.avg_per_day > o.across_rating_avg
